blocks.text: Japanese food lovers are in for a special treat as Watami Japanese Casual Restaurant celebrates its 14th anniversary with an exciting ₱14 Sushi Ladder promotion on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. For one day only, customers can enjoy a selected eight-piece sushi roll for just ₱14 when they purchase any entrée from Watami’s regular menu at participating branches nationwide. How to avail the ₱14 Sushi Ladder To qualify for the anniversary offer, guests must order at least one regular-priced entrée while dining at Watami. For every qualifying entrée purchased, customers become eligible to buy a Sushi Ladder for ₱14. However, only one […]...
